board.empty: No runs yet this week. Be the first!
board.title: Weekly leaderboard
board.unavailable: The leaderboard isn't available right now.
game.claw.controls: Steer with the arrows, then hit DROP over your pick.
game.claw.tagline: Drop the claw, catch a virtual plush. Just for fun, no physical prize.
game.claw.title: Aegyo Claw
game.flappy.controls: Tap anywhere to flap your lightstick. Your first tap starts the run.
game.flappy.tagline: Flap your lightstick through the barricades to reach the stage.
game.flappy.title: Bias Flap
game.freebie.controls: Drag to catch the falling merch. Arrow keys work too.
game.freebie.tagline: Catch the swag before it drops.
game.freebie.title: Freebie Frenzy
game.frogger.controls: FORWARD and BACK only. Cross when the street is clear.
game.frogger.tagline: Dodge the street and get past security. 10 levels, 3 lives.
game.frogger.title: Cross to the Concert
game.hangman.controls: Tap letters to guess the fan slang before your guesses run out.
game.hangman.hint.aegyo: Cute, exaggerated charm an idol performs.
game.hangman.hint.bias: Your favorite member in a group.
game.hangman.hint.comeback: A group's return with new music after a break.
game.hangman.hint.daebak: Slang for something amazing, a jackpot moment.
game.hangman.hint.fanchant: What the crowd shouts along during a song.
game.hangman.hint.maknae: The youngest member of a group.
game.hangman.hint.sasaeng: An obsessive fan who crosses privacy lines.
game.hangman.status.lost: Out of guesses! The word was {term}.
game.hangman.status.solved: Daebak! Solved with {lives} guesses to spare.
game.hangman.tagline: Crack the fan slang before you run out of guesses.
game.hangman.title: Guess the Slang
game.jumper.controls: Drag left and right (or use the arrow keys) to land your bounces.
game.jumper.tagline: Bounce up the charts. Don't flop off the top 100.
game.jumper.title: Comeback Climb
game.snake.controls: Swipe or tap the arrows to turn. You move on your first input.
game.snake.tagline: Grow your photocard collection without crashing the fan-sign line.
game.snake.title: Aegyo Snake
game.thisorthat.controls: Tap a card (or press the left/right arrows) to pick. Nine rounds.
game.thisorthat.tagline: Nine quick picks. Find your fan-day vibe.
game.thisorthat.title: Fan Day: This or That
game.thisorthat.vibe.adventurous.blurb: Sunrises, night markets, new streets. Your fan day is an expedition.
game.thisorthat.vibe.adventurous.name: Adventurous
game.thisorthat.vibe.cozy.blurb: Soft blankets, warm snacks, favorite B-sides. Your fan day recharges you.
game.thisorthat.vibe.cozy.name: Cozy
game.thisorthat.vibe.creative.blurb: Charms, fan art, playlists. You turn fandom into something you made.
game.thisorthat.vibe.creative.name: Creative
game.thisorthat.vibe.energetic.blurb: Choreo, arcades, one more round of everything. You ARE the encore.
game.thisorthat.vibe.energetic.name: Energetic
game.thisorthat.vibe.social.blurb: Karaoke, group chats, shared fries. Your fan day is better with everyone in it.
game.thisorthat.vibe.social.name: Social
host.countedBlocked: Today's run is done. Next one after {time}.
host.countedUnavailable: Today's run isn't available right now. Practice is.
install.android.step1: Tap the menu (three dots, top right).
install.android.step2: Tap "Add to Home screen" or "Install app".
install.android.step3: Confirm. Launch it like any other app.
install.android.title: Android (Chrome)
install.desktop.step1: Click the install icon at the right end of the address bar.
install.desktop.step2: Click "Install". The arcade opens in its own window.
install.desktop.title: Computer (Chrome / Edge)
install.intro: Aegyo Arcade installs like an app: full screen, one tap away, no store needed.
install.ios.step1: Tap the Share button (the square with an arrow).
install.ios.step2: Scroll down and tap "Add to Home Screen".
install.ios.step3: Tap "Add". The bunny appears on your home screen.
install.ios.title: iPhone / iPad (Safari)
install.title: Play from your home screen
portal.tagline: K-pop mini-games. Light, fast, one hand.
portal.title: Aegyo Arena Arcade
